title: Recording: Call Me Back Again, Medicine Jar by Wings | 1975
content:
Sea-Saint Recording Studio, New Orleans
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Alan O’Duffy, Ken Laxton, Roberta Grace

Wings worked on two songs for the Venus And Mars album on 3 February 1975.

The main purpose of the session was to record the backing track for ‘Call Me Back Again’. It had Paul McCartney on guide vocals and clavinet, Jimmy McCulloch and Denny Laine on electric guitars, and Joe English on drums.

Linda McCartney then overdubbed chords on a Mellotron’s flute setting, Paul added a bass guitar part, and he, Laine, and studio engineer Alan O’Duffy recorded three-part vocal harmonies during the choruses.

The session also involved work on ‘Medicine Jar’, although the details are unknown.
